record.context_brief: Endpoint Lorentz estimate for Riesz transforms
record.original_question: Let R=(R_1,...,R_n) be the vectorial Riesz transform, let p' be the conjugate exponent to p, and write |Rf| for the Euclidean norm of the Riesz-transform vector. Is it true or false that there is a constant C such that the endpoint Lorentz-space estimate ||f||_{L^{(p,infinity)}}^{p-1} <= C ||sum_{alpha=1}^n R_alpha(|Rf|^{p-2} R_alpha f)||_{L^{(p',infinity)}} holds?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.2. Let R = (R1 , . . . , Rn ) be the vectorial Riesz transform. Is it true or false that kf kp−1 L(p,∞) ≤ C kΣnα=1 Rα (|Rf |p−2 Rα f )kL(p′ ,∞) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ and let $1<p<\infty$, with $p'=p/(p-1)$ the conjugate exponent. For a Schwartz function $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, let $R=(R_1,\ldots,R_n)$ denote the vectorial Riesz transform on $\mathbb{R}^n$, where $R_\alpha$ is the singular integral operator with Fourier multiplier $-i\xi_\alpha/|\xi|$, and write $|Rf|=\bigl(\sum_{\alpha=1}^n |R_\alpha f|^2\bigr)^{1/2}$. For a measurable function $g$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, let $\|g\|_{L^{(q,\infty)}}=\sup_{t>0} t\,|\{x:|g(x)|>t\}|^{1/q}$ denote its weak-$L^q$ (Lorentz) quasi-norm.

Determine whether there exists a constant $C=C(n,p)$ such that, for every Schwartz function $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}$,
$$\|f\|_{L^{(p,\infty)}}^{\,p-1}\;\le\;C\,\Big\|\sum_{\alpha=1}^n R_\alpha\bigl(|Rf|^{p-2}\,R_\alpha f\bigr)\Big\|_{L^{(p',\infty)}}.$$
Prove the inequality with such a constant $C$, or exhibit a sequence of functions showing it must fail.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem (an endpoint Lorentz-space variant of an inequality involving the vectorial Riesz transform). A web search did not turn up a published proof or counterexample resolving this specific weak-type endpoint estimate, so it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Sharp weak type estimates for Riesz transforms
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp weak-type (L^{p,\infty}) estimates for Riesz transforms are studied, but no resolution of the specified nonlinear endpoint inequality is given.
status_evidence.claim: Existing weak-type results for Riesz transforms do not resolve the proposed endpoint Lorentz inequality.

status_evidence.snippet: Endpoint estimates for Hodge/Riesz-type systems are an active area, with several open endpoint questions remaining.
status_evidence.claim: Endpoint estimates of this type remain an active area of research with open questions.
